text: Mila is a monkey who lives deep in a mountainous forest
tagalog_text: Si Mila ay isang unggoy na nakatira sa isang bulubundukin na gubat.

text: There are lots of fruits in the forest, like banana, papaya, and durian
tagalog_text: Maraming prutas sa gubat na ito, tulad ng saging, papaya, at durian.

text: Our first president was Emilio Aguinaldo.
tagalog_text: Ang ating unang presidente ay si Emilio Aguinaldo

text: Our second president was Manuel Roxas.
tagalog_text: Ang ating pangalawang presidente ay si Manuel Roxas.

text: One day, Mila was walking in the forest when she came across a strange object!
tagalog_text: Isang araw, naglalakad si Mila sa kagubatan nang may nakasalubong siyang kakaibang bagay!
